title: Raise logit softcap 15 -> 30
description: One line in GPT.forward: softcap = 15 -> 30, so final logits pass through 30*tanh(z/30) instead of 15*tanh(z/15); nothing else touched.
reflection: NEGATIVE and clearly outside noise: val_bpb 0.990249 vs baseline 0.986277, i.e. +0.0040, about 4x the ~0.0009 noise floor. The change was a perfect control -- 71.3M params, FLOPs/token 3.460347e8 (vs baseline 3.460393e8, identical to 5 digits), 332.8M tokens vs 331.5M, 2539 steps vs 2529, steady-state MFU 38.63% vs 38.48%, peak VRAM 32.9GB both ways. It even saw 0.4% MORE data and still lost, so this is 100% quality, no throughput confound. Final smoothed TRAIN loss also regressed (2.7720 vs 2.7685), so the damage is to optimization, not to eval-time calibration: the softcap is not a dead early-training guard as I argued in #83, it is an active part of the training dynamics. Best reading: 15*tanh(z/15) bounds the gradient the lm_head can push back into the residual stream (d/dz of s*tanh(z/s) = sech^2(z/s), which decays twice as fast in z at s=15 as at s=30). Doubling s therefore doubles the effective unembedding gradient scale late in training, on top of an already high EMBEDDING_LR/UNEMBEDDING_LR -- so the softcap has been doing double duty as an implicit output-side LR damper all along, and the tuned value is tighter than it looks. Consequences for the remaining budget: (a) do NOT probe softcap upward again, and removing it entirely is now predicted worse, not better; (b) the interesting direction on this axis is DOWNWARD (softcap 10), which is cheap to test and would confirm the damper story, but I would only buy it if nothing better is on the table; (c) more generally, this closes the 'output head is untouched free money' hypothesis -- the output head is tuned, like every other axis in this cell. Axis status after 6 rounds: batch flat, head split negative, depth positive but exhausted, width flat, FLOP-free embedding capacity negative, output softcap negative. With 5 runs left I would point them at the attention window pattern (the last genuinely untouched region) rather than at further output-head or capacity probes.
